## 2024-03-01 - Form fields without linked labels
**Learning:** Found several input components (like in `SettingsTab` and `ProductsTab`) generated by `shadcn/ui` lacking proper label associations. Relying only on visual proximity or placeholders isn't sufficient for screen readers. Using simple `name` attributes inside `<label>`s does not create accessibility links.
**Action:** When using `shadcn/ui` or custom inputs, explicitly link `<label>`s and `<Input>`s using the `htmlFor` and `id` attributes. If an input has help text, explicitly use `aria-describedby` to link them. For complex data tables with repeating inputs (e.g. `ProductsTab`), always apply an `aria-label` string dynamically associated with the specific row context (like `${product.title}`).
